ask: can u make a grid so we can all tap when we're free this week and see the best slot
sentence: A weekly grid of days and time-of-day slots where each person taps the slots they are free, and the slot with the most people free is shown and can be pinned.
use_when: A group needs to find a time this week when most people are free
Everyone should mark their own availability on one shared grid
The group wants to see the best slot and lock it in
dont_use_when: Choosing between a few fixed options like places or dishes, which needs a poll
Booking an exact clock time or a calendar invite for one person
Splitting costs or tracking tasks, which need a different tool
